_note: Trigger → case map. Single source of truth for the five 'Który przypadek?' units AND the in-app Przypadki reference panel (James, 2026-08-07). Organised by TRIGGER because the governor is what the learner meets first. 'taught_by' must name a live node; the panel shows a row only once that node is at/behind the learner's furthest fruited position, so it can never spoil. When a new governor ships, add its row here in the same run.

cases.job: naming — the dictionary form, and the subject of a sentence
the thing an action lands on — the direct object
where something is, and what a topic is about — never without a preposition
what you are, what you travel by, who you are with
the person something is given, said or done FOR

triggers.gloss: naming something

triggers.trigger: the subject — who is doing it
triggers.gloss: the actor of the verb
a verb acting on a thing
saying something is absent
destination
origin
quantity and nearness

triggers.trigger: w / na — meaning WHERE something is
triggers.gloss: static position, never movement
what someone IS
naming more than one
counted things from five up
company — the same word z, a different job from z + Genitive
means of transport, no preposition at all
liking and tasting — learned whole at A2
what you are talking about
what you are comparing against
the person you help or thank
the person who receives it

triggers.trigger: ANY negated verb, not just nie mam
triggers.gloss: negation takes the object's case away
asking FOR something — o's second job

triggers.trigger: na… (going TO an activity or event)
triggers.gloss: an activity or event, not a place — a place takes do
the thing you are waiting for — czekać chooses na
the way through — not the destination, which takes do
a stretch of time the action filled
the doer in a passive sentence — never the means, which is the Instrumental
who something came from — a PLACE takes z/ze instead
when something starts — do closes the other end
